Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are already out in the middle. Kashyap Prajapati and Jatinder Singh are the two openers for Oman. Junaid Siddique to start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Vriitya Aravind is up for a chat. He says that the wicket is much slower than the last game. Adds that he and Rameez Shahzad talked about batting till the 25th over to take the game deep. Admits that they had a collapse in the middle but praises Aayan Khan for his brilliant knock in the end. Credits Zahoor Khan and Karthik Meiyappan for providing support as well. Reckons that they are 20-25 runs short but backs their bowlers to make a game out of this.

For Oman Jay Odedra was the pick. He turned the game by picking important wickets at important times. The spinners for them, yet again did a really good job but they will be disappointed with how things ended. They probably let United Arab Emirates off the hook a little. They though will fancy themselves to chase this down as they chased a score a lot more than this. United Arab Emirates on the other hand, will have to bowl really well if they are to defend it. Join us in a bit for the chase.

Oman will be very pleased with their performance but United Arab Emirates will be happy with their recovery. They have got to a competitive score on a wicket which is on the slower side. However, at one stage, they looked like getting a lot more. After losing Muhammad Waseem and Rohan Mustafa early, the likes of Vriitya Aravind and Rameez Shahzad steadied things. However, the going was slow and when the time came to accelerate, Rameez Shahzad fell. Once he fell, United Arab Emirates lost wickets in heaps. Had it not been for a brilliant innings from Aayan Khan, they probably would have been bundled out for below 200. His innings has got his side to a competitive score.

FOUR! Aayan Khan finishes off with a flurry! Bilal Khan misses his yorker and bowls this full, outside off, Aayan Khan slices it well wide of short third man for a boundary. United Arab Emirates ends up on 227/8!

Commentary.Commentary: Done with the pre-match formalities! Oman players spread out to take their respective field positions. Muhammad Waseem and Rohan Mustafa are the two openers for United Arab Emirates. Bilal Khan has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...
We are moments away from the game, but before that, the players line up for their respective national anthems. It will be United Arab Emirates' first followed by the national anthem of Oman.

Muhammad Waseem, the captain of United Arab Emirates says that they were looking to bat anyways as the pitch looks slow and low. Adds that they lost the last game but the preparation has been good for them and they will look to put on a good performance. Says that Junaid Siddique is back in the side.

Zeeshan Maqsood, the skipper of Oman says that they will bowl first. Adds that there will be a bit of swing early on and they will look to utilize that. Tells that he is fully fit after an injury scare earlier. Mentions that they will look to do the same things and the approach will remain the same. Informs they are unchanged.

Oman (Unchanged Playing XI) - Kashyap Prajapati, Jatinder Singh, Aqib Ilyas, Zeeshan Maqsood (C), Mohammad Nadeem, Shoaib Khan, Ayaan Khan, Naseem Khushi (WK), Jay Odedra, Fayyaz Butt, Bilal Khan.
TOSS - Oman have won the toss and decided to BOWL first.

On the flip side, United Arab Emirates comes into this game with a lamentable loss against the Lankans. They failed to perform with the bat and ball, and will look to leave that behind to bounce back in this one. Can they do it? Or will Oman's side make two in two? Let's find out soon. Hello and a warm welcome folks! Oman and United Arab Emirates will lock horns in the 8th match of the ICC World Cup Qualifiers at Bulawayo Athletic Club, Bulawayo. Oman's side comes into this game high on confidence. They put up an astonishing show against the Irish side and will look to repeat the same in this game.
... MATCH DAY ...

Oman and United Arab Emirates will lock horns in the 8th match of the ICC World Cup Qualifiers. The game will be played Bulawayo Athletic Club, Bulawayo. Oman pulled off a fabulous win over Ireland in their opening encounter courtesy of splendid batting contributions from Kashyap Prajapati, Zeeshan Maqsood, Aqib Ilyas, and Mohammad Nadeem. The side will have to work a bit on their bowling unit and try to restrict their opponents to a low total in this encounter. On the other hand, United Arab Emirates suffered a comprehensive defeat at the hat and of Sri Lanka. They had a target of 355 on the board and were bowled out for 180 in their allotted fifty overs. The side failed to deliver with both bat and the ball. They will look to bounce back and win this one and improve their chances of qualifying. Can they do it? Or will Oman make two wins in two games? We shall find out together.
